use: Cover artwork. Fictional editorial illustration, not an image of a real organisation or research participants.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: cover illustration for a university manager training presentation, BUS230 using ADKAR with context and evidence. Create a refined editorial illustration of a fictional small retail stockroom, two adult store colleagues discussing a barcode scanner and a delivery carton near shelves. Make it calm and professional, flat textured editorial raster style, warm off-white background, deep navy and muted teal with a little warm amber. Landscape aspect ratio 3:2. Composition: subjects and shelving occupy the right two-thirds with generous uncluttered off-white negative space on the left. Avoid all words, lettering, logos, brand marks, watermarks, numbers, dashboards, and invented evidence. No photorealism, no chart, no diagram. The scene is fictional and illustrative.
